status: Requested Version 3 revision; not production approval
prompt:
Make a focused edit of this exact supplied Version 3 book cover. Keep the same portrait aspect ratio and the same composition, illustrated drawing style, typography, text, title size and position, subtitle, author, decorative two-leaf title sprout and lower-right clockwise YouTube sticker. Do not redesign the cover or change any wording.

Required changes:
1. Remove ALL pale sage/light green BACKGROUND fill from both the upper courgette-flower illustration and the lower tomato illustration. Replace those flat backgrounds, including every gap between stems, leaves and fruits, with the SAME warm cream paper background as the central title area. One continuous subtle cream field from top to bottom; no green rectangles, panels, tints, horizontal seams or colour bands. Preserve the actual green plants and their original vivid colours.
2. Gently reshape the lower silhouette of the upper illustration so that it flows into the cream page, rather than stopping at one straight horizontal baseline. Retain the two large yellow courgette flowers, angled connected stems and leaf arrangement. Use an irregular, natural contour: a few complete petal tips and two or three leaf lobes extend modestly below the old panel edge, especially at far left and far right where there is clear space. Avoid a uniform edge where all leaves and petals stop at the same height. Keep the main flower group approximately its original size and position, with only small local adjustments to petal/leaf contours. The flowers must not grow larger. Leave a clean gap above 'The' and above the separate title sprout; NO petal or leaf may cover any lettering or touch the title sprout. If necessary draw the central petal outline slightly higher while allowing side foliage to dip a little farther down. The result should remain restrained, just enough overlap to feel integrated.
3. The lower tomato composition and foreground sticker stay in their existing positions and sizes; simply let cream show behind the tomatoes and foliage. The sticker remains on top, same slight clockwise tilt and soft paper-edge shadow.

Exact wording to preserve: 'The' / 'Vegetable' / 'Guru'; 'Your at-a-glance' / 'growing companion'; 'John Lennon'; sticker 'As seen on' / 'YouTube' / '@hackriculture'. Retain current rounded chunky lettering and all centred alignments. No new text, decorations, border, photo-realism, watercolour, outline art or extra fruit. One flat complete front cover, not a book mockup.
